sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by XL.
Ability Power scales with the number of Sword/Axe type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 4XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Sword/Axe type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Passive Effects]
Increases ATK/MATK of Swords and Axes by 30%.
